children: Waste Energy announced that Chairman and CEO Scott Gallagher purchased 400,000 shares of common stock in open-market transactions.
Scott Gallagher bought 315,000 shares at $0.0029 and 85,000 shares at $0.0028 on Sept. 1, 2026.
His direct ownership increased from 1,305,714 to 1,705,714 shares, signaling insider conviction.
Disclosure made under Regulation FD while Gallagher completes EDGAR access updates; Form 4 to follow.
